name: free-ride
description: Manages free AI models from OpenRouter for OpenClaw. Automatically ranks models by quality, configures fallbacks for rate-limit handling, and updates openclaw.json. Optional Groq, Gemini and Cerebras
descriptionZh: 管理OpenClaw的OpenRouter免费AI模型，自动按质量排名模型，配置速率限制备用方案，并更新opencla...

en.tagline: Sets OpenClaw to free OpenRouter models with fallbacks
en.summary: FreeRide configures OpenClaw to use free AI models from OpenRouter. It ranks the free models, sets the best one as the primary model, and adds ranked fallbacks so that rate limits do not stop the user. It updates only the model keys in openclaw.json and keeps the rest of the config as it is.
problem: Free AI models on OpenRouter change often, and some hit rate limits. Setting one model by hand means the user must check which free models work and switch when one fails.

With FreeRide, the user runs one command to set a free primary model and an ordered fallback chain. Before each write, the config is copied to a backup file. If the primary is one FreeRide set, the watcher can rebuild the chain when it fails.
fit: A user who wants OpenClaw to run on free models
A user who hits OpenRouter rate limits and wants automatic fallback
A user who wants to reduce AI costs and keep a paid primary model as a fallback option
unfit: A user who needs a specific paid model as the only primary and no fallback changes
A user who cannot set an OpenRouter API key
steps: The user sets OPENROUTER_API_KEY in ~/.openclaw/.env or in their own shell.
`freeride auto` ranks the free OpenRouter models and saves the user's old primary model.
FreeRide writes agents.defaults.model.primary, agents.defaults.model.fallbacks and the model allowlist in openclaw.json, after making a backup copy.
The user runs `openclaw gateway restart` so OpenClaw loads the new config.
If the user wants more free tiers, `--providers` adds Groq, Gemini or Cerebras to the fallback chain. Each one needs its own key and plugin.
`freeride restore` puts back the previous primary and fallbacks.

zh.tagline: 让 OpenClaw 使用 OpenRouter 免费模型并配置备用
zh.summary: FreeRide 让 OpenClaw 使用 OpenRouter 上的免费 AI 模型。它会对免费模型排序，把最好的一个设为主模型，并添加有序的备用模型，使速率限制不会打断用户。它只更新 openclaw.json 中的模型相关字段，其余配置保持不变。
problem: OpenRouter 上的免费模型变化较快，部分模型会触发速率限制。手动设置一个模型意味着用户需要自己判断哪些免费模型可用，并在某个模型失败时手动切换。
使用 FreeRide 后，用户运行一条命令即可设置免费主模型和有序的备用链。每次写入前，配置会先备份。如果主模型是 FreeRide 设置的，失败时 watcher 可以重建备用链。
fit: 希望 OpenClaw 使用免费模型运行的用户
遇到 OpenRouter 速率限制、需要自动切换备用的用户
希望降低 AI 成本，并保留付费主模型作为备选的用户
unfit: 只想使用某个指定付费模型、且不希望改动备用配置的用户
无法设置 OpenRouter API 密钥的用户
steps: 用户在 ~/.openclaw/.env 或自己的 shell 中设置 OPENROUTER_API_KEY。
运行 `freeride auto`，对 OpenRouter 免费模型排序，并保存用户原来的主模型。
FreeRide 先备份，然后在 openclaw.json 中写入 agents.defaults.model.primary、agents.defaults.model.fallbacks 和模型允许列表。
用户运行 `openclaw gateway restart`，让 OpenClaw 加载新配置。
如果用户需要更多免费服务，可用 `--providers` 把 Groq、Gemini 或 Cerebras 加入备用链。每个都需要各自的密钥和插件。
运行 `freeride restore` 可以恢复之前的主模型和备用模型。
